missing_elements: Impacted Repositories/Systems is not stated as an explicit bulleted list of repo names. It is inferable from the API Extensions section ('openshift/api' discriminated union) and implementation details (secrets-store-csi-driver-operator), but never enumerated as a discrete 'Impacted Repos' item the way the Motivation/Proposal sections enumerate other facts.

quality_issues.quote: allow cluster administrators to configure secret rotation behavior (enable/disable, polling interval) and workload identity federation (WIF) token audiences through the ClusterCSIDriver custom resource
quality_issues.suggestion: Two related-but-separable capabilities (secret rotation config and WIF tokenRequests) are bundled into one enhancement. They share the same `SecretsStore` API surface and reconciliation paths, so bundling is reasonable, but consider adding one sentence in Scope explicitly justifying why they ship together (shared API/config object, same CR watch, no independent rollout need) so reviewers don't need to infer it.

quality_issues.quote: As a cluster administrator, I want to disable automatic secret rotation for workloads that use static secrets...
quality_issues.suggestion: User stories are not phrased as Given/When/Then. This is a non-blocker because the Test Plan section (Unit/API Integration/E2E) already supplies concrete, traceable scenarios that functionally substitute for per-story acceptance criteria — but promoting a few of those scenarios into explicit Given/When/Then under each user story would tighten the direct traceability from story to test.

quality_issues.quote: Mitigation: OpenShift document will suggest users to choose a wise value.
quality_issues.suggestion: The mitigation for the 'minimumRefreshAge set too low' risk is vague ('a wise value'). Consider stating a concrete recommended floor/range (e.g. 'documentation will recommend >= 60s for typical provider rate limits') or note that no CRD-enforced floor beyond the generic Minimum=1 exists, so guidance is advisory only.

non_blockers: Sizing: rotation + WIF tokenRequests bundled under one enhancement (shared API surface) — not blocking, but worth a one-line justification
Mitigation for low minimumRefreshAge values relies on doc guidance rather than a concrete recommended value or additional CRD-level floor
Impacted repositories (openshift/api, secrets-store-csi-driver-operator) are inferable from content but not explicitly enumerated as a list
